description: Smith & Wesson’s Extreme OPS Folding Knife is the ultimate tool for outdoor enthusiasts and everyday carry (EDC) aficionados. Designed with a versatile, partially serrated combo blade, this knife excels in cutting through tough materials like rope and fabric, making it indispensable for camping, hunting, and survival situations. The blade is made from rugged stainless steel, ensuring long-lasting sharpness and durability. With a blade length of 3.25 inches and an overall length of 7.38 inches, this folding knife strikes the perfect balance between portability and functionality. The textured black aluminum handle enhances your grip, providing comfort and control even in wet or slippery conditions. Additionally, the survival knife comes with a convenient pocket clip, allowing you to easily mount it on your pants, belt, or backpack for quick access. Whether you’re heading into the wilderness or need a reliable EDC tool, the Smith & Wesson Extreme OPS Folding Knife is your go-to companion.
